title: MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - HERNANDEZ) relative to funding for fire recovery, ongoing maintenance and repairs in Council District Seven.
text:
[Council File 26-1567; CD 7]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - HERNANDEZ) relative to funding for fire recovery, ongoing maintenance and repairs in Council District Seven.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the City Controller to transfer $270,000 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281207 CD 7 Redevelopment Projects- Services to the Community Investment Department, Economic Development Trust Fund 62L, Dept. 21, and establish a new Appropriation account and increase appropriations for the same amount in Account No. 21E5AU Pacoima Lifestyle Center Operations and Maintenance (O&M) for fire recovery, ongoing maintenance and repairs.
2. AUTHORIZE the Community Investment Department to make any technical corrections or clarifications as necessary to the above fund transfer instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion.
3. AUTHORIZE the General Manager of the Community Investment Department, or designee, to amend City contract no. C-205417 with Agora Realty and Management, Inc for the purpose of repairs, maintenance and operations at the Pacoima Lifestyle Center, to increase the contract amount by $270,000 for a new contract total of $318,000, and to extend the term through June 30, 2027.
